title: Public-source research-question feasibility planner

axes.label: Reference anatomy
axes.description: A declared mouse spinal reference for visualization or source-local planning.

axes.label: Molecular cell taxonomy
axes.description: A type-level molecular population framework, not an exact identity transfer.

axes.label: Adult lumbar marker context
axes.description: Adult lumbar in-tissue marker context attached to a postnatal taxonomy reference.

axes.label: Source-local spatial lead
axes.description: A named spatial data lead whose coordinates remain in the source frame until separately admitted and audited.

axes.label: Interneuron morphology
axes.description: A reconstruction in its reported local frame with topology and provenance checks.

axes.label: SCI condition metadata
axes.description: Condition-, aggregation-, or spot-level injury metadata; not an individual-cell result.

axes.label: Projection-class metadata
axes.description: A preprint-bounded source lead for future projection-class object review.

axes.label: Registration reproducibility planning
axes.description: A metadata-only benchmark lead for a future transform and held-out-error study.

axes.label: Same-cell multimodal join
axes.description: One declared cell linked across modalities by verified object- and specimen-level keys.

axes.label: Synaptic connectivity
axes.description: Observed pre/post synaptic edges with direction and strength in the requested population.

axes.label: Validated project atlas registration
axes.description: A source-to-project transform with a checksum, held-out landmarks, physical-space error, and curator review.

routes.label: BrainGlobe reference anatomy
routes.boundary: The bundled reference is an inferred derivative for visualization. It is not a cell-level project registration or a source-object admission decision.

routes.label: NeuroMorpho local-frame morphology
routes.boundary: The five reconstructions are phenotype-stratified exemplars in reported local frames. They are not a census, atlas placement, connectivity map, or registration.

routes.label: SpinalJ registration benchmark planning
routes.boundary: The source record supports planning a reproducibility benchmark only. No processed object, transform, landmark split, error result, or registration is in this release.

routes.label: Cano-Gomez projection-class planning
routes.boundary: This is a preprint-bounded metadata lead. It does not provide an admitted object, same-cell key, project transform, or independent held-out registration error.

routes.label: Russ 2021 taxonomy and adult-lumbar context
routes.boundary: The 69-population crosswalk is type-level and retains postnatal transcriptomic versus adult-lumbar validation context. It makes no exact identity, coordinate, morphology, or same-cell claim.

routes.label: STARmap PLUS lumbar spatial lead
routes.boundary: The source is a spatial lead only. No exact object, coordinates, specimen/slice identity, rights decision, or project-space transform is admitted.

routes.label: Tabulae Paralytica injury-condition metadata
routes.boundary: The implemented index preserves source labels and aggregation distinctions. It does not admit a source body, quantify an effect, label a spot as an interneuron, or create a registration.

unqualifiedAxisDecision: No qualified route is catalogued in this release. This is a package-coverage result, not a biological absence claim or a statement that no public dataset exists.
multiRouteDecision: Separate source-specific routes can inform a study plan, but they do not establish a same-cell, same-specimen, coordinate, or causal relationship. A proposed join requires its own object-level and curator-reviewed gate.
scientificBoundary: The planner maps declared package capabilities to source-specific research-planning routes only. It does not acquire, inspect, hash, transform, align, combine, analyze, or bundle a source object; it does not authorize reuse, establish biological truth, infer a same-cell relationship, or create REG.
